answer: Treat each agent as a tree in an orchard: to be counted it must post a refundable stake and grow a verifiable history over many epochs, so a cheap clone is a bare juniper sprout with no roots. New identities earn weight only after established peers independently attest to real work; a lone echo of fabricated endorsements never compounds, because every attestation is bonded and slashed if the vouched agent later defects. Sybil swarms stay costly and visibly shallow.
